blocks.html: For zoning lots in R8A Districts, or in Commercial Districts mapped within, or with a residential equivalent of an R8A District, within 100 feet of a wide street located outside of Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas, the underlying height and setback provisions applicable to an R8 District within 100 feet of a wide street shall apply. However, sky exposure plane buildings shall not be permitted, and the additional height allowances for eligible sites set forth in Section 23-434 (Height and setback modifications for eligible sites) shall not apply.

However, sky exposure plane buildings shall not be permitted, and the additional height allowances for eligible sites set forth in Section 23-434 (Height and setback modifications for eligible sites) shall not apply.
